TM.title: Crispy Potato Nuggets 🥔✨ Prep Time: 15 mins | Cook Time: 20 mins | Servings: 3-4 INGREDIENTS Potato Nuggets 4 medium Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into even chunks 2 slices bread 3 tbsp cornstarch 1 1/2 tsp salt (split: 1 tsp for boiling water, 1/2 tsp for dough) 1 tsp pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp aromatic seasoning 1/2 tsp chili flakes Oil, for frying INSTRUCTIONS 1. Place potato chunks in a pot of water with 1 tsp salt. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat and cook for 12–15 minutes until fork-tender. Drain well, return to the hot empty pot for 1 minute to let excess steam escape, then mash until completely smooth. 2. Quickly dip the 2 slices of bread into a bowl of water just until softened. Press firmly between your hands to wring out as much water as possible, then tear into tiny bits. 3. Add squeezed bread, 3 tbsp cornstarch, remaining 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp aromatic seasoning, and 1/2 tsp chili flakes to the mashed potatoes. Knead or mix thoroughly until smooth and uniform. 4. Rub a drop of oil on your hands if tacky. Divide dough into 16–20 equal portions, roll into balls, flatten slightly into oval nuggets, and press gently with fork tines to create ridges. 5. Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering (about 375°F). Fry nuggets in batches for 2–3 minutes per side until deeply golden brown and crunchy. Drain on a paper-towel-lined plate and serve hot. #Recipe #cooking #asmr #FoodTok
TM.author: Zach Choi

Poco a poco todo fue quedando como nuevo. Y lo más bonito: el señor, con lo desordenado que es, adora a su gatico, y tiene cuatro hijos que llegaron a acompañarlo. Roberto is a 63 year old husband and father, currently working as a chef in Las Vegas. Recently, Roberto was building his new home, went to the store to grab supplies and came back to his home being all in flames.  Roberto put his entire life savings into the home, losing his belongings, including his car in the process. To make matters worse, the insurance company is not covering the cost of the damages and lost items. Roberto works as a chef and his wife works as a porter at the nearby Red Rock Casino, but as a hard working couple in hopes of retiring one day, this tragic experience and news is detrimental to their future.  Let's all come together and show Roberto the power of the internet and bless him and his family. 100% of the net funds raised will go to covering Roberto’s living expenses and finding him a home. Be kind and love always ❤️
